actinopterygii.note: ray-finned fishes; a class, so there is no order or family

polychaeta.note: bristle worms; a class (GBIF also has an unrelated insect genus of that name)

bambusoideae.note: bamboos; a subfamily of the grasses

isoptera.note: old name for the termites; they are now classed inside Blattodea

termitoidae.note: the termites; classed inside Blattodea, no single family
